meta.description: Character LoRA on Z-Image Turbo (Tongyi-MAI/Z-Image-Turbo). Ported from LoRA Dataset Studio's researched built-in (rank 32/alpha 32 = community default, lower-regret for hard faces; sigmoid timesteps per Ostris' subject guidance). Prose captions with a unique trigger word. Steps: LDS computes ~120/image clamped [1500,3500] — 2500 here is the midpoint; scale to your set. Sample settings assume the distilled Turbo (CFG 1, 8 steps). v1.1 (2026-08-29): arch is zimage:turbo with Ostris' training adapter (assistant_lora_path) — v1.0 paired the Turbo weights with the base zimage arch and no adapter, i.e. trained the distilled model directly. For base Z-Image instead, set arch zimage, name_or_path Tongyi-MAI/Z-Image and drop assistant_lora_path. Speed (2026-08-29): latents are served from RAM after the first pass (cache_latents + cache_latents_to_disk — disk-only caching re-read every latent every step), loss_sync_every 4, ui_db_poll_seconds 2. Training math unchanged.
